title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: Bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. Variance refers to the model's sensitivity to fluctuations in the training set.

title: Impact of Removing a Feature
text: When you remove a feature from a model, it can lead to an increase in bias because the model has less information to make accurate predictions.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Removing a feature can decrease variance because the model becomes simpler and less sensitive to the specific data points in the training set.
